import contextlib, io, pytest, sys
output = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output), contextlib.redirect_stderr(output):
    status = pytest.main(['tests/test_consensus_contract.py', '-q'])
print('consensus contract checks passed' if status == 0 else output.getvalue())
sys.exit(status)
